meta.note: Primary sources only. EU = Eurostat COMEXT DS-045409 (EUR, qty in 100kg converted to kg); United Kingdom = HMRC uktradeinfo OTS (GBP, kg, import flows 1+3 summed). valueUsd is converted at the ECB reference rate in fxToUsd; valueNative/nativeCcy hold the unconverted figure. Quantities are NET MASS in kg. Shares are quantity-based. WARNING 1: Netherlands and Belgium include quasi-transit trade (Rotterdam/Antwerp effect) and are 25-42% above the same country's UN Comtrade declaration - do not treat as domestic consumption. WARNING 2: 2026 covers 2026-01..2026-07 for BOTH sources - a part year, not a full one; never compare its absolute level against a full year. No estimation or interpolation: missing items are absent, not filled.

fx.note: ECB reference rates; GBP->USD is cross-derived as (USD/EUR)/(GBP/EUR)
